description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the noncreature artifact enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
When the Munitions token enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the noncreature artifact returned in step 1 and the Munitions token, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Grinding Station by sacrificing the noncreature artifact.
Repeat.
